description: The done-gate of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-23, docs/PROOF-GATE.md), its rules: what a run of the owner's checks says, what it does to the outcome of a task, the notice and the host message, the acceptance file and the baseline a task is held to, the rounds and the reuse, what runs nothing, the receipts, the stall counters and the final text (lib/proof/gate.mjs, lib/agent-progress.mjs, lib/final-text.mjs). The wiring into the agent loop is in proof-gate-agent.json.
